feeds.description: Not Dressed As Lamb is the personal style blog of Catherine Summers, a British over 40 woman blogging about style, fashion, women's issues, ageing, health and beauty (who is anti-age appropriate). Subscribe to get latest articles from this blog in your inbox.

feeds.title: Midlifechic » Style
feeds.description: Midlife Chic is a UK blog for women over 40 who are getting their groove back. Written by the former editor of Selfridges magazine, it focuses on classic chic featuring high street fashion and beauty. It is a forum for midlife women to discuss the issues that they face as they enter into the second half of their life.
